preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some LuffyInu tokens to sell
Attacker must NOT be the owner and NOT be in excludeFee mapping

violation_target.exploit_hint: The vulnerability is that when selling tokens to the pair (uniswapV2Pair), the liquidity fee is transferred to the pair address but not actually added to liquidity. This means the fee tokens remain in the pair contract as regular tokens rather than being converted to LP tokens. Attack by: 1. Ensure taxStatus is true, 2. Sell LuffyInu tokens to the uniswapV2Pair, 3. The liquidity fee (1%) will be sent to the pair but not properly added to liquidity, 4. The attacker can then buy back tokens at a lower price or manipulate the pool since the fee tokens remain in the pair contract as sellable assets rather than locked liquidity.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The LuffyInu contract has a flawed fee mechanism where liquidity fees (1% on sells) are transferred to the pair address but not actually added as liquidity. This means the pair contract receives tokens that aren't locked and can be swapped out. The fee tokens remain in the pair as regular tokens, creating an imbalance where the pair has more tokens than it should relative to ETH reserves. An attacker can exploit this by selling tokens (triggering the fee), then buying back at a lower price due to the artificial token surplus in the pair.
attempts.attack_strategy: 1. Impersonate owner to enable taxStatus (required for fees to apply). 2. Get LuffyInu tokens using deal(). 3. Sell tokens through PancakeSwap router to trigger the sell fee mechanism. 4. The liquidity fee (1%) will be sent to pair but not locked. 5. Buy back tokens at lower price due to imbalanced reserves. 6. Profit from the price difference in ETH.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Label addresses for debugging. 2. Impersonate owner to call setTax(true). 3. Use deal() to give attacker LuffyInu tokens. 4. Approve router to spend attacker's tokens. 5. Record initial ETH balance. 6. Sell tokens via swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens. 7. Record ETH balance after sell. 8. Optionally buy back tokens to demonstrate further profit. 9. Assert ETH balance increased.
